title.topic:
The Exodus from Egypt—
the Passover
title.point: God had a very exact plan for getting His people out of Egypt. We can be those who follow the instructions of those who care for us.

lastWeekReview.title: Moses—Going to Pharaoh
bullets: God sent Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh: "Let My people go!" But Pharaoh said NO!
Pharaoh made things WORSE — forcing Israelites to make bricks without straw.
Moses got discouraged, but he went back to God and was encouraged again.
God sent TEN plagues — blood, frogs, lice, flies, livestock sickness, boils, hail, locusts, darkness — each worse than the last!
After each plague, Pharaoh hardened his heart and said NO again.
Moses went back to Pharaoh 12 times! God doesn't give up and neither should we!
lastWeekReview.discussion: 📖  When have you felt like giving up? How can we go back to God like Moses did?
lastWeekReview.verseQuote: "Be strong and take courage; do not be afraid or dismayed. For Jehovah your God is with you wherever you go." — Joshua 1:9

kidsContent.text: God had a very detailed plan to get His people out of Egypt. Every step was important — even the parts that seemed strange!
Step 1: Each family chose a lamb without any blemish — a perfect lamb.
Step 2: They roasted the lamb and prepared bitter herbs and unleavened bread (bread made without yeast — no time to let it rise!).
Step 3: Before eating, they took the lamb's blood and painted it on the doorpost and the top of the door frame using a hyssop branch.
Step 4: They ate the meal dressed and ready to go — sandals on, staff in hand, expecting to leave any moment!
The Israelites followed God's plan EXACTLY — and it saved them!

image.caption: Applying the lamb's blood on the doorpost

kidsContent.text: At midnight, God's final plague came. Every firstborn in Egypt died — from Pharaoh's son to the prisoners' children. But every house with the blood on the doorpost was PASSED OVER. Not one Israelite was touched!
There was a great cry in all of Egypt! Pharaoh called Moses in the middle of the night and said: "GET OUT! Take your families, your cattle — everything — and GO!"
The Egyptians even gave the Israelites silver, gold, and clothing — payment for all their years of slave labor!
Because the Israelites followed God's plan exactly, their firstborns lived and they were finally FREE!
🌟 Sometimes adults have a plan for us that seems hard to follow. But just like the Israelites, when we follow instructions carefully, it keeps us safe and leads to the best result!

image.caption: The Israelites leave Egypt — free at last!

lesson.practicePoint: This week, practice following instructions exactly — from parents, teachers, or coaches — even when you don't fully understand why. Trust that they care for you! Share your experience next week.

memoryVerse.text: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise at the end of your days.
memoryVerse.application: The Israelites listened carefully to God's instructions and followed them exactly — and it saved their lives! When we listen to counsel from our parents, teachers, and God, we become wise and stay safe.

parts.text: Materials: Large paper, markers, numbered instruction cards, red paint/marker for 'blood'
Teams receive a set of 6 scrambled instruction cards (one for each step of the Passover). They must put them in the CORRECT order!
Card 1: Choose a lamb without blemish. Card 2: Roast the lamb. Card 3: Prepare bitter herbs and unleavened bread.
Card 4: Paint blood on the doorpost with hyssop. Card 5: Eat dressed and ready — sandals on, staff in hand. Card 6: Stay inside until morning!
Round 2: Add 4 WRONG instructions mixed in (e.g., 'Open the door at midnight', 'Leave before eating'). Teams must identify and remove the wrong ones!
Discussion: Why was it so important to follow EVERY step? What would have happened if they skipped the blood on the doorpost?
📖 Connection: God's plan had to be followed exactly. Following instructions keeps us safe!

rolePlayScript.text: Scene: An Israelite home in Egypt. A family is gathered together. It is evening.
God had sent nine plagues, but Pharaoh still said NO. Now God told Moses about the final, most terrible plague — and gave His people an exact plan to be saved.
Moses, tell all the families of Israel: each household must choose a lamb — a perfect lamb, without any blemish.
Listen carefully, everyone! God has a very exact plan. We must follow EVERY step!
I've chosen our lamb — it's perfect, not a single spot on it.
Father, why do we need the lamb's blood? That sounds strange!
God said to paint the blood on our doorpost with a hyssop branch. When He sees the blood, He will PASS OVER our house and we will be safe!
Father paints blood on the doorpost. Mother prepares unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
Everyone — put your sandals on! Get your staff! We eat standing up tonight, ready to leave at any moment!
Why are we eating in such a hurry?
Because tonight, God is setting us FREE! We must be ready to go!
Midnight comes. A great cry is heard throughout Egypt.
At midnight, God's final plague came. Every firstborn in Egypt died. But every house with the blood on the doorpost was PASSED OVER — not one Israelite was touched!
Moses! GET OUT! Take your people, your families, your animals — everything — and GO!
God had an exact plan — and following His instructions saved His people! Let's be those who listen carefully and follow the instructions of those who care for us!

description.text: Setup: Two teams. Course represents the steps to leave Egypt.
Station 1: Pick up a stuffed animal ('lamb') and carry it to station 2.
Station 2: Use a red marker to draw on a paper door frame ('blood on the doorpost').
Station 3: Put on sandals and grab a 'staff' (pool noodle), then race to the finish.
At the finish line, shout: 'We were slaves, but now we're free!'
📖 Connection: The Israelites had to follow each step in order — and so do you!
Materials: Stuffed animals, red markers, paper doors, sandals, pool noodles
Setup: Tape red paper on 4 'doorpost' spots around the gym (safe zones). One player is 'the plague'.
Rules: Kids run around the gym. When the leader shouts 'MIDNIGHT!', the plague starts tagging.
Kids are safe ONLY if they reach a red doorpost. Each doorpost fits max 3 kids!
If tagged outside a doorpost, you sit out that round. Reset after each round.
📖 Connection: Only those under the blood of the lamb were safe — the doorpost saved them!
Materials: Red paper/tape for 4 doorpost zones

movieViewing.title: God's Passover
movieViewing.description: TBTMS story video — The Passover night! God instructs His people to prepare the lamb and put blood on the doorpost, saving them from the final plague. (Exodus 12)

description.text: Hide 8 instruction cards around the outdoor area. Each card has one step of the Passover plan.
Teams must find ALL cards AND arrange them in the correct order to 'escape Egypt'.
Twist: 3 'wrong instruction' cards are also hidden. Teams must identify and discard the wrong ones!
First team to find all correct cards, put them in order, and discard the wrong ones wins!
Materials: 11 printed cards (8 correct + 3 wrong), answer sheet for verification

outdoor.tip: 🐑 This is the first Passover — a huge moment in Israel's history! Help kids understand that following God's exact plan saved their lives. Connect it to following instructions from parents and teachers today.
